summary: The independent warrant-preservation oracle is fixed. R1-F1 remains unresolved: ordinary dataset snapshots still omit RelationClaimV2. Filing a proposal does not satisfy the explicit snapshot integration requirement. Review was static; supplied test results were not independently rerun.

evidence: Read all 1007 lines of diff.patch and opened all six changed files under tree/.
Compared the implementation with plan.md and L11: changes address relation metadata, admission, compatibility and structural tests.
Mapped all ten expanded sealed criteria to tests and inspected their assertions and rejection paths; detailed mappings appear in loophole_audit.
Checked I1–I2: added fixtures are TEST-ONLY, optional values remain absent, and legacy purposes are UNSPECIFIED.
Checked I3, I5–I9: exact predecessor and intent pins are validated; relation storage does not promote provenance, alter hypothesis state, execute decisions or combine confidence.
Checked I12 against the unchanged presentation allowlist and test_private_relation_text_never_changes_public_payload.
tree/src/eval_lab/relation_v2.py:111 registers the new artifact; tree/src/eval_lab/persistence.py:217 integrates transactional pin validation.
tree/src/eval_lab/pilot.py:338 still omits v2 relations from snapshot roots, while tree/src/eval_lab/pilot_domain.py:150 rejects them as submission artifacts.
tree/loop/proposals/STEP-0009.toml:3 acknowledges the missing integration but supplies no implementation or snapshot test.
Inspected positive, negative, copied-input, historical-revision and competing-writer tests; rejection helpers require specific errors and unchanged stored rows.

test_authored_argument_literals_survive_storage_reopen_and_successor now uses independently authored, distinct purpose/warrant/qualifier/rebuttal literals and checks raw SQL bytes, digest, replay, reopening and successor preservation.
Verified that replacing warrant with purpose would fail the new literal assertions; this sensitivity assessment was static.
Parsed all three changed Python files successfully and checked documentation against the implementation. gate.json reports 700 passing tests; runtime execution was not independently verified.
Read changed comments, docstrings, documentation and report claims; found no external methodological or standards claims requiring research.
Independently verified the diff hash, all five reported product/proposal hashes, and the 717 changed non-report lines.
Verified that added-file contents match diff.patch and that the report's sealed Plan matches plan.md.
Checked documented vocabulary, compatibility behavior and version boundaries against source. Documentation explicitly acknowledges absent snapshot discovery.
Compared the complete diff with the sealed implementation scope and DEFERRED items D01–D14; no deferred capability is implemented.
Checked I4, I10–I11 and I16: no protected files, dependencies, existing tests, harness code or judging contracts appear among changed paths.
Checked I13: tool versions and hashes are recorded and complete fixed-input determinism has an independent literal oracle.
Checked I14–I15 within available evidence: no prohibited implementation or branch operation appears in the diff; supplied G14 reports unchanged pilot listing and remote main.
The additional proposal is administrative material outside the planned product-file list; it does not implement the excluded snapshot work.

blocking_findings.description: R1-F1 remains unresolved. Dataset snapshot discovery starts from dataset submissions, sessions, derivatives and bindings, then follows outgoing references. RelationClaimV2 is neither discovered directly nor admitted through PilotSubmission. Consequently, a stored v2 relation pointing to included evidence or intent is omitted from ordinary dataset exports, including its authored purposes, anchors and argument text. The proposal acknowledges this gap but does not satisfy the user's explicit requirement that new types be pinned in snapshots. The sealed-plan exclusion remains a conflict, not an accepted resolution.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Resolve the scope conflict through the applicable approval process and complete the required private snapshot integration. Verify relation references, digests, authored fields and exact dependencies in an exported TEST-ONLY dataset snapshot, and verify that appending a successor leaves the earlier export unchanged.
